title: THE PERSON I WAS UNDERESTIMATING
passages: I wrote about respecting the power in other people. Then I had to turn the thought around. What about the way I spoke to myself? The doubts about how I looked, how I dressed, whether my life was polished enough to belong in the room.

I could recognize cruelty when it came from someone else. Learning to recognize it in my own internal voice was another kind of work. This chapter began with a decision to stop dismissing myself before anyone else had the chance.

reflections.prompt: Whose voice do you hear when you underestimate yourself?
Write down one dismissive thing you tell yourself. How would you respond if a friend said it about themselves?
Choose one sentence you would say to encourage a friend. Read it back to yourself before your next small challenge.
